ops.title: Phase 4 cleanup: fold the four remediation workflows and three scripts back into ci.yml / Taskfile
ops.description:
User instruction, 2026-07-28: *"at the very end after we do all this we should clean up and remove those 4 workflows we are adding now"* — and, on the scripts: *"(and scripts too)"*.

The v1 remediation added scaffolding that must not become permanent cruft. Leaving seven new top-level CI artifacts in place would reproduce, in the build system, exactly the accretion the remediation is removing from the code.

**What was added (commit `20f9337`, amended by `15d22da`):**

| Artifact | Purpose | Disposition at v1.0.0 |
|---|---|---|
| `.github/workflows/fleet-build.yml` | compiles 10 consumers against HEAD | **keep the gate, fold into `ci.yml`** as a job — it is a standing rule ("fleet-build red = no release, ever"), not scaffolding |
| `.github/workflows/export-census.yml` | allowlist diff | **keep the gate, fold into `ci.yml`** — same reason |
| `.github/workflows/mixed-era.yml` | cross-era session gate | **keep the gate, fold into `ci.yml`** once `SKEW_EXPECT: pass` — same reason |
| `.github/workflows/docs-drift.yml` | package-table drift | **fold into `ci.yml`** as a step in the existing lint job |
| `scripts/fleet-build.sh` | fleet-build driver | keep the logic; expose as a `task` target so it is invocable locally the same way CI invokes it |
| `scripts/export-census.sh` | thin wrapper over `ci/exportcensus` | **delete** — collapse into a `task` target calling the Go program directly |
| `scripts/gen-package-table.sh` | table generator + `--check` | keep the logic; expose as a `task` target |

**The distinction that matters:** the *gates* are load-bearing and permanent — they are the standing rules Phase 4 freezes. What is disposable is their packaging as four separate top-level workflows and three loose shell scripts. Consolidating means one `ci.yml` with named jobs and one `Taskfile.yml` surface, so a contributor has one place to look and one command to run.

**Do not delete a gate to satisfy this task.** Removing `fleet-build` or `export-census` would discard the two mechanisms that make the collapse provable. If consolidation turns out to cost a gate, keep the gate and leave the workflow file.

Sequenced for **Phase 4 (v1.0.0 freeze)**, after the collapse soaks — the gates must stay maximally visible and independently re-runnable through Phases 1-3, when they are doing the most work.

ops.text: The four remediation workflows are folded into ci.yml as named jobs (or steps), and .github/workflows contains no remediation-era scaffolding file
Every gate that existed before consolidation still runs and still fails the build on the same conditions — proven by deliberately breaking each one and observing red
scripts/export-census.sh is deleted; fleet-build and gen-package-table are reachable as Taskfile targets rather than loose scripts
task lint, task build, and scripts/test.sh -race -count=1 ./... green after consolidation
The standing rules ('fleet-build or mixed-era red = no release') still name a real, runnable check
